title: M3a x M5b - closing-range breakout with abnormal-volume confirmation (daily, PIT top-200 turnover universe)

primary_family.cells: N in {20,63} x H in {5,20} x side in {up,dn}
primary_family.statistic: mean over formation dates with >=1 B and >=1 C event of [mean_B f - mean_C f]
primary_family.test: one-sided calendar-aware Newey-West, lag = H, Student-t n-1 df
primary_family.multiplicity: Holm over the 8 VAL cells at alpha 0.05; HOLDOUT Holm over the VAL-confirmed cells

estimand: f = sign * (R_i - R_m) * 1e4 bp; R = C[t+H]/O[t+1]-1 (adjusted); R_m = equal-weight mean over PIT members with a resolved window

classification.C5: no VAL cell confirmed, or VAL-confirmed but HOLDOUT read and unconfirmed (construct-scoped)
